subject: order units for a specific region??

messages.author: 05f6ff70ac5d518a
messages.subject: order units for a specific region??
parts:
Hi all,
I want to get the unit indices for a specific region on a specific
chromosome ordered by physical position. To get the indices for a
region, I use

gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf)
indices <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosomes=1, region=c(1,5e6))

But the getUnitsOnChromosome() function does not take an orderBy
argument.
My suggestion is to pass the ...-argument of the
getUnitsOnChromosome.GenomeInformation()
to getData(). It would then be possible to get the ordered indices
with

indices <- getUnitsOnChromosome.GenomeInformation(gi, chromosomes=1,
region=c(1,5e6), orderBy="physicalPosition")

As I am very new to aroma.affymetrix, I am not sure if there is
another way to get the ordered indices. Please let me know, if there
is.

Thanks a lot in advance,
Thomas Kellermann

I hope you ment to write getUnitsOnChromosome(...) and not
getUnitsOnChromosome.GenomeInformation(...); the latter is not the
correct approach because it circumvents the S3 method dispatching
mechanism.

>
> As I am very new to aroma.affymetrix, I am not sure if there is
> another way to get the ordered indices. Please let me know, if there
> is.

Supporting 'orderBy' here would be nice. However, introducing that
would require a contract (by me/the API) that that field is going to
be named 'physicalPosition' across all GenomeInformation sources etc.
This is something I haven't decided on yet and it is likely not
happening too soon.

Instead, you can order the manually like this:

gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf);
units <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosomes=1, region=c(1,5e6));
pos <- getPositions(gi, units);
o <- order(pos);
pos <- pos[o];
units <- units[o];

Hope this helps

Henrik
